title: Holcim acquires Cem'In'Eu Group
content:
France: In its third quarter financial results, Holcim has announced the acquisition of Cem'In'Eu Group. No value for the transaction has been disclosed.

Cem'In'Eu's first plant, Alienor Ciments in Tonneins, was inaugurated in 2018. Its second facility, Rhone Ciments in Portes-les-Valence, began operating in 2021. Both sites have a production capacity of 240,000t/yr of cement.

title: JSW Cement commissions two capacity expansion projects
content:

title: Amrize releases financial results for the third quarter of 2026
content: US: Amrize has released its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, which ended on 30 September 2026. The company reported that revenues increased by 2.2% year-on-year to US$3.8bn, with net income also rising by 3.3% to US$0.56bn. Adjusted earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) increased to US$1100m.

title: Kohat Cement Company reports earnings growth
content:
Pakistan: Kohat Cement Company has reported an increase in its financial performance for the first quarter of the fiscal year 2027, with earnings reaching US$11.9m.
